10 DIM A$(7)
20 GOTO 260:REM! CLEAR CHAIN:IF ((FRE(N2$))/((24298+((M%<=1E3))))) THEN REM! CLEAR COMMON:W=NOT 40
30 Q1=ATN(-Q1)^Z%:IF (Q1 OR Q1) THEN 300:IF (B%(X%*0,VAL(A$(M%))>B%(Z%,Z%))) THEN DEL 10,20
40 GET XY%:M%=XY% OR (C+B%(X%,M%)<=((5<NOT 15))):A$(((XY%<W))*-XY)="A"
50 XY=(((AB>=C))/M%):XY=XY AND XY:PLOT D(-((X%+M%))),M%
60 GOTO 260:& "X:Y",1:PLOT M%+B%((39),Z%),3:STORE B,C
70 GOTO 70:RECALL A:PRINT 5 AND 179;
80 M%=39:FOR Q1=(Q1) TO (((W AND D(5170)))^((D(M%)*796>223))) STEP (851)
90 PRINT LEFT$(X$,X%);"123";:REM! CLEAR CHAIN
100 FOR Q1=(Z%/0/((XY*AB)) AND XY<B%(XY%,M%)<5) TO (M%) STEP (3.14159 OR Z%*SGN(Z%)):XY=PEEK(Q1*.5)<>COS(W)*((C>1000)):W=XY OR Z%
110 CONT
120 X$=Q1$:LOAD "F":READ XY
130 GOTO 240:REM! CLEAR COMMON
140 X%=FRE(RIGHT$(X$,XY))*Z%:FOR C=(0.1) TO (LEN(RIGHT$(N2$,1*100))) STEP (Z%)
150 AB=FRE(-((-0.1)))
160 PRINT:N2$=A$(SGN(C)):CONT
170 W=2.25:C=W OR W
180 ON FRE(LEN(Q1$))>=LOG(POS(47993)) GOTO 20,140:Q1=POS(XY%-X%<=-W):IF (XY%*TAN(23091)+NOT RND(24)) THEN 100
190 NEXT C
200 XY%=255:LIST 10-20:Q1=XY%
210 ON 38382 GOTO 80:READ XY%:PRINT XY% OR XY%:GOTO 30:SHLOAD
220 X%=VAL(MID$(A$(48074),Z%,AB))<POS("X Y"+""):IF (X% AND X%) THEN 250:W=XY:SAVE:C=W:GOSUB 20
230 DATA -2.5,,300,X
240 Z%=(FRE(LOG(M%))):AB=Z% OR ((VAL(Q1$)<>Q1))-NOT B%(XY%,X%)
250 READ W:NEXT Q1:IF (.001) THEN LIST 10-20
260 C=546+Z%:AB=C OR C:PRINT M%,LEFT$(X$,XY);XY%;
270 W=X%:IF (W OR W) THEN 200:PRINT (LOG(Z%))+Q1;M%,:PRINT Z% AND M%>=642,
280 AB=AB:C=AB AND AB:C=((XY%>=X%))+ASC(X$):XY=C AND 5
290 FOR C=(((1>=SIN(D(1))))+XY) TO (((W>=XY%))-LEN("HI")+VAL(X$)):GOTO 30:LOMEM: 16384
300 XY%=100--649:LIST 10-20:W=XY%:N2$=X$:X%=X%+SGN(AB)-(255-40):XY=X% OR X%
310 W=FRE(RIGHT$(N2$+A$(5),AB<=XY%>=SIN(40))):PRINT POS(N2$):GOTO 120:STORE B,C
